name: rigol-scope
description: Control a Rigol oscilloscope (verified on a DHO804) from Claude: settings, acquisition, triggers, measurements, 16-bit waveform capture and screenshots, plus skills for first-time setup and safe operation.

scope_address.title: Scope address (blank = find it on USB)
scope_address.description: Leave blank to find the Rigol on USB automatically. For LAN use TCPIP0::<ip>::INSTR or tcp://<ip>:5555. A USB resource string such as USB0::0x1AB1::0x044D::<serial>::INSTR also works.

scope_serial.title: Scope serial number (only if several Rigols are on USB)
scope_serial.description: Used with a blank address to choose between several Rigol instruments connected by USB.

read_only.title: Read-only mode
read_only.description: Hide every tool that changes the scope's setup (channels, timebase, acquisition, triggers, run/stop). Measurements, captures and screenshots still work.
